editorialIntro.heading: Distinctive Character Form
editorialIntro.paragraph: Chiku SZ25 presents a 160cm silicone character build with a clearly defined visual identity. The yellow skin, sculpted character hair, fixed 12cm tail, purple eyes, and golden-yellow styling create a look that stands apart from more conventional formats. The EVO skeleton, articulated fingers, bolt-free hard standing feet, gel breasts, and gel buttocks are part of the listed configuration, while the custom-made process allows selection from the stated skin and body-function options. The photographed outfit serves only as a separate styling reference, keeping the emphasis on the doll’s form and the factory’s tailored approach to the model.

title: Dolls Castle Natalie S112 80cm Silicone Doll
